_README: VENDORED SNAPSHOT of the orchestrator connection-type vocabulary (Data-Flow-Advisory/orchestrator @ feat/drift-gate, types.json commit 7f84e5f399a8d1a8bcab02c50f25d16654d956e0) PLUS this organ's locally-proposed additions (marked `proposed: true`). The canonical vocabulary lives in the orchestrator repo; this file is a snapshot so the conformance Action can validate ports.json offline (the orchestrator repo is private and unreachable from the GitHub-hosted runner without auth). Proposed types are awaiting upstream review per CONNECTORS.md rollout step 2 ('extending types.json when a genuinely new type is needed; new types reviewed, not minted freely'). Two organ ports connect iff their `type` matches. See CONNECTORS.md.

TenantContext.desc: A resolved tenant: identity, branding, provenance bag.

SiteCrawl.desc: Signals crawled from a prospect's website at signup.

InterviewTranscript.desc: Ordered Q&A pairs from a discovery interview.

KeyFacts.desc: Themed facts extracted from a transcript (the discovery memory).

EntityGraph.desc: Deduplicated canonical entities (people, systems, tools) per tenant.

Blueprint.desc: The system blueprint: modules + integrations + current/recommended state.

ProcessFlow.desc: Sequence / swimlane of a workflow extracted from transcript themes.

AccountState.desc: A fleet account's pacing/quota state (the pace + drift gates' input).

ClaimVerdict.desc: Whether a worker may claim work now, and why (gate output).

BillingState.desc: A tenant's subscription / billing state + feature entitlements.

ConformanceVerdict.desc: Whether an organ/output conforms + groundedness (self_metric shape).

ApparatusSource.desc: A pointer to something the fresh apparatus should scan for useful specs/features — the OLD apparatus or any source.

RawArtefacts.desc: Raw scanned content from a source, before it is decomposed into discrete features.

CandidateFeatures.desc: Discrete specs/features decomposed out of the raw scan — the candidates to judge.

JudgedFeatures.desc: Candidates after judgment — the useful ranked, the useless rejected (reject is first-class).

ProvenancedArtefact.desc: Any spec/feature the scan-and-select takes from the OLD apparatus, wrapped with its origin + succession status so the new machine knows it as inherited, never native. Retain history, know it as such — succession baked in, the antidote to old-artefacts-polluting-new. See FRESH_APPARATUS.md.

SessionResult.desc: The result envelope a fleet worker (claude -p) posts to /persona-work/<id>/complete — a free-text summary plus structured findings (and optional spawn_tasks). organ-proposal-review's `team_review` kind consumes this as RAW model output, extracting the embedded review JSON from `summary`/`findings[0]` before normalising. Distinct from ModelJsonOutput: SessionResult is the un-parsed worker envelope (text in, JSON not yet extracted); ModelJsonOutput is already-parsed JSON.

ModelJsonOutput.desc: An already-JSON-parsed LLM output object awaiting deterministic normalisation — the post-parse, pre-normalise intermediate. organ-proposal-review's `critique`, `interviewee_review` and `synthesis` kinds consume this (the impure Claude call + json.loads happen OUTSIDE the organ; the organ receives the parsed dict, or null on a parse failure, and applies fail-open normalisation). A deliberately loose object because the shape varies by the review fragment being normalised.

ProposalReviewPerspective.desc: One stakeholder's normalised, attribution-stamped perspective on a proposal — covers a DFA team-persona review (`team_review`), a Haiku persona critique (`critique`), and an AI-reconstructed interviewee review (`interviewee_review`). All three are members of the same family: a single named reviewer's structured view, list-coerced and (for AI-generated perspectives) stamped `ai_generated:true` for EU AI Act Article 13 attribution. The downstream `synthesis` step consumes a LIST of these as `dfa_team_perspectives` + `interviewee_perspectives`. Field set is a superset across the three sub-shapes; a given perspective carries the subset for its origin.

ProposalReviewSynthesis.desc: The normalised cross-perspective synthesis of a proposal review — the team + interviewee perspectives folded into a prioritised change_list (each change carrying EU AI Act Article 13 source attribution: source_type + source_label, defaulted to 'unknown'/'' when missing), a quote-weaving map, and an overall readiness score. Produced by organ-proposal-review's `synthesis` kind; the actionable end of the review pipeline.

ReviewJobStatus.desc: The derived overall status of a multi-job proposal review (a synthesis job plus its per-persona child jobs). organ-proposal-review's `status` kind derives `overall` ∈ {not_found, complete, failed, running, pending} from the synthesis job status and whether any child is still pending/running. A small status wire a polling UI or the approvals queue can consume to decide whether the review is done.
